name: SquidBots Lite (CoA Bots add-on, client add-on)
description: The CoA Bots add-on: a thin bar of bot orders, the bots' roles on your party frames, bot offers as small toasts, and My alts with a sheet for every bot. Yu'lon puts it into your CoA client's Interface/AddOns by itself and brings it up to date when you update the server; nothing is written to the server. Remove it here and Yu'lon leaves it out from then on.
notes: FOLLOWS RELEASES (T126, T870): Install and Update take the newest published release's commit, not the
branch tip. Zyth45/squidbots-addon tags v<x.y[.z]> on the same day as each CoA Bots (mod-playerbots) release;
the tags are not one-to-one with the server's, so the add-on follows the newest release and moves with the
server's Update the server to latest (T814's pairing), not with the server's tag.
ON BY DEFAULT (T870): one of CoA's default add-ons (controller_wow_coa.modules.DEFAULT_ADDONS), put in by
itself at a fresh install, at every tab open and at Play, never again once the player removed it (T612). Only
into a folder that holds Interface/ or ascension.exe. A copy the player brought from a link or a folder wins.
Only `SquidBotsLite/` is copied: the repository root also holds README, images/ and release/ (old zips).
The tag's SquidBotsLite/ tree is byte-identical to the release zip SquidBotsLite-v<ver>.zip (checked for
v2.9.1, 2026-11-04). Interface 30300 against this entry's 30300 CoA client. Update client never writes
Interface/AddOns/SquidBotsLite/ (coa_client._EXCLUDED_TREES). Remove leaves the folder in the client, as for
every shipped add-on; the game's AddOns menu turns it off. "Check for updates" counts only modules/, so this
mod gets no update count (T855's known limit); a manual Update follows releases.
Credit: SquidBots Lite by the CoA Bots team (Zyth45), GPL-2.0. Yu'lon downloads it from GitHub on the
player's computer and ships none of its files.
